name: RegionalIntensity
description: Half-hourly carbon intensity and generation mix for one of the 17 GB Distribution Network Operator (DNO) regions, published by National Grid ESO. Each record covers a specific DNO region identified by its numeric region ID. Derived from the carbon-intensity feeder schema published in the xRegistry catalogue. The sample demonstrates the forecast/outturn contrast that a settlement-period feed carries: the same observed property is reported twice for one half-hour, once as a modelled forecast issued ahead of the period and once as the calculated outturn settled after it. It shows forecastIssueTime and forecastLeadDuration alongside the flattened settlement-period boundaries phenomenonTimeStart and phenomenonTimeEnd, phenomenonTimeRelation interval on every value that characterises the period rather than an instant, a fixed half-hourly cadence on the period start, featureOfInterest on the region identifier, and status on the qualitative index band. Every result member is optional; a channel that National Grid ESO did not publish for a given settlement period is omitted from the record rather than nulled.

region_id.description: Numeric identifier for the DNO region as assigned by the Carbon Intensity API (1-17). It identifies the distribution region whose electricity supply is characterised by this record.

dnoregion.description: Full name of the Distribution Network Operator region (e.g. 'Scottish Hydro Electric Power Distribution').

shortname.description: Short display name for the DNO region (e.g. 'North Scotland').

period_from.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp marking the start of the half-hour settlement period. Settlement periods tile the day without gaps, so the producer is expected to publish one record per region per half-hour slot.

period_to.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp marking the end of the half-hour settlement period. The period is half-open: the end instant belongs to the following settlement period.

published_at.description: Instant at which National Grid ESO issued the regional forecast product covering this settlement period. It precedes period_from, because the forecast is published ahead of the period it describes.

forecast_lead.description: Interval from published_at to period_from: how far ahead of the settlement period the forecast was issued.

forecast.description: Forecast carbon intensity for this region and settlement period in grams of CO2 per kilowatt-hour (gCO2/kWh). Produced by the National Grid ESO regional forecasting model from predicted demand, interconnector flows and plant dispatch, so it is a model output rather than a measurement.

actual.description: Outturn carbon intensity for this region and settlement period in grams of CO2 per kilowatt-hour (gCO2/kWh), settled once metered generation for the period is available. Obtained by applying published fuel-type emission factors to the settled generation mix, a deterministic calculation that no named summary function describes. Absent for settlement periods that have not yet settled.

index.description: Qualitative index band for the regional carbon intensity. The band is a published classification of the reported intensity against seasonally revised thresholds, not an independent quantity.

description.very low: Lowest published band; the regional intensity is well below the seasonal average.
description.very high: Highest published band; the regional intensity is well above the seasonal average.

biomass_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from biomass in this region during this settlement period. Regional shares are attributed by the National Grid ESO regional dispatch model, which allocates national generation to distribution regions.

coal_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from coal in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.

gas_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from natural gas in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.

hydro_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from hydroelectric power in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.

imports_pct.description: Percentage of electricity supplied via interconnector imports in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.

nuclear_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from nuclear power in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.

oil_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from oil in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.

other_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from other or unclassified fuel sources in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.

solar_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from solar photovoltaic installations in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.

wind_pct.description: Percentage of electricity generated from wind turbines in this region during this settlement period, attributed by the regional dispatch model.
